bg_tai.desc: Chinese shanshui ink wash of Mount Tai: granite peaks, stone stairway to summit gate tower (Nantianmen-like), pines lower-left, sea of clouds, empty sky upper-left for text, NO sun (opening/ending background)

dragon_red.desc: traditional Chinese dragon (long) in vermilion red ink on plain white, side view flying right-to-left, antlers, whiskers, five claws, flaming pearl; composite with multiply blend

A0.desc: Confucius character reference: standing front-facing, grey beard, black cap, ochre/cream hanfu, plum blossoms

A1.desc: walled town of Lu on loess plain, Spring and Autumn soldiers with ge halberds and war chariot, terracotta sky

A2.desc: poor boy in patched hemp beside thatched granary on stilts and brown ox, millet fields

A3.desc: teenage boy kneeling at low table reading bamboo slips by bronze oil lamp, mud-brick room

A4.desc: Confucius teaching under apricot tree (xingtan), students kneeling on mats, one offering dried meat

A4c.desc: Confucius eyes closed listening to Qi court music: bianzhong bells, stone chimes, pan-pipes; untouched bowl of meat

clip_A4.desc: Wan 2.2 clip of A4: Confucius raises hand and nods, student offers bundle, petals fall (5 s)
